newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Japanese Emperor Akihito arrives in Sao Paulo.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Emperor Akihito arrives in Sao Paulo.

text.p: Japanese Emperor Akihito and Empress Michiko arrived on Wednesday in Brazil's sprawling industrial city of Sao Paulo, home to the largest Japanese community outside Japan.

The imperial couple, midway through a nine-day visit to Brazil, landed at Sao Paulo's international airport in a private jet after spenidng a full day in Belo Horizonte, the prosperous capital of Minas Gerais state, an airport spokeswoman said.
While in Sao Paulo, the couple will meet with leaders of Brazil's 1.3 million strong Japanese community, most of whom reside in the city.
They will also meet with state officials and visit the University of Sao Paulo, South America's largest university.
The couple was scheduled to leave Sao Paulo on Friday for Rio de Janeiro. They were due to fly to Buenos Aires on Monday for a three-day visit to Argentina.
